summary: The sonnet candidate is the only one whose text is essentially verbatim (all numbers, units, points and source misprints check out against the pages), so the gold is built from it; its failures are two figure crops — the solutions p.4 graph loses its whole y-axis scale and the p.3 circle crop swallows the task heading and clips the circle — plus dropped equation numbers in the problem 2 solution and a handful of minor wording normalisations. The haiku candidate fails on content (a missing p_m paragraph, the field axis changed from Z to X, invented and dropped equations, an inverted optics sentence, a mangled table, no solution figures, all three problem crops wrong) and the glm candidate fails on figures (all seven crops clip labels or swallow body text), a false page-window caveat, a wrong vector identity and decimal points turned into commas. Of the checkers, the glm checker's reports on haiku are all true positives (15/16, one mis-pathed info note is false); its report on sonnet is mixed (3/7 true, two 'caption clipped' findings and the catalogDisagrees/2a-annotation claims are false, and it rated the critical y-axis clipping as minor); the haiku checker passed the glm candidate with an empty defect list, missing seven critical crops, and produced no findings to grade.
